title: A SegFormer-based model for spatial Daylight Factor prediction with comprehensive obstruction encoding and regulatory validation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33737v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Daylight compliance assessment in residential buildings requires time-consuming raytracing simulations and specialist model preparation, limiting its integration into iterative architectural design. We present a machine learning-based methodology for predicting the spatial distribution of the Daylight Factor (DF) directly within Building Information Modelling (BIM) environments, delivering results in seconds without model export or manual curation. The approach addresses five gaps not jointly covered by any existing model: external obstruction encoding including balconies, own building height, variable material reflectances, non-orthogonal room geometries, and regulatory validation. Two models are developed: a default-materials model with fixed reflectances for preliminary design checks, and a custom-materials model with variable project-specific reflectances. translated_title: 基于SegFormer的采光系数空间预测模型：具备全面的遮挡编码与法规验证
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.33737v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：住宅建筑的采光合规性评估需要耗时的光线追踪模拟和专门的模型准备工作，这限制了其与迭代式建筑设计的整合。我们提出了一种基于机器学习的方法，可直接在建筑信息模型（BIM）环境中预测采光系数（DF）的空间分布，无需模型导出或人工整理，即可在数秒内给出结果。该方法解决了现有任何模型均未同时覆盖的五个空白：包括阳台在内的外部遮挡编码、自身建筑高度、可变的材料反射率、非正交的房间几何形状，以及法规验证。本文开发了两个模型：一个是采用固定反射率的默认材料模型，用于初步设计检查；另一个是采用可变的项目特定反射率的自定义材料模型。两者均在大约20,000个由Radiance模拟生成的合成房间上进行训练和验证……
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于SegFormer的机器学习方法，可直接在BIM环境中数秒内预测采光系数的空间分布，填补了包括阳台遮挡编码、自身建筑高度、可变材料反射率、非正交房间几何形状及法规验证在内的五项现有模型空白。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a SegFormer-based machine learning approach that predicts the spatial distribution of Daylight Factor directly within BIM environments in seconds, filling five gaps not jointly covered by existing models: obstruction encoding including balconies, own building height, variable material reflectances, non-orthogonal room geometries, and regulatory validation.
